reference_method: Manual transcription from rendered PDF regions; the included scan-page transcription was visually checked against the full-resolution source page.
protocol: Copy the manually labeled region from the original PDF page, preserving its source image; run the existing DocumentProcessor PDF upload path (PyMuPDF/Tesseract fallback), then score chunk text against the manual reference.
limitations: Production-parser OCR path only; two English governance scan regions, no table-cell or layout-structure labels, no paired OCR-engine comparison. Throughput includes parser/OCR invocation but excludes application embedding and database persistence.
render_dpi: PDFProcessor uses a 1.5 page matrix (nominal 108 dpi); source page images are preserved in the cropped PDF.
